rows.grounds: fused form of japanaṃ + ca + eva; coordinated object with emphatic particle
action carried out by the practitioner
agent; compound of sādhaka and uttama

items.question: What ritual acts are performed by the foremost practitioner?
premises: The foremost practitioner is the agent of the action.
Worship is performed by this practitioner.
Recitation is also performed by this practitioner.
items.inference: The foremost practitioner performs both worship and recitation.
items.plain_english: The foremost practitioner performs worship and recitation.
